RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so the all-male composition of the panel provides no plausible basis for sex discrimination in the hiring decision. While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity shortcomings within the municipality's leadership, it is not evidence of bias against you based on sex.

Raising the panel's gender makeup would appear baseless and could damage your professional reputation in municipal planning. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback. The municipality likely prioritized public consultation and stakeholder management experience over formal planning credentials for this director-level role.
